reason: The archival tag no longer describes the engine on master: since v0.9.0 the package gained six modules, sleep.py lost 1777 lines to a refactor, memory.py changed, and the guard skipped every comparison at version 0.12.0 and above. The guard is re-baselined on the shipped engine so that the next change to it has to be deliberate.
how_to_change: Change the engine deliberately: bump the version, add a CHANGELOG entry, then update this file's commit, engine_version and date in the same commit. The guard fails until the reference is updated, which is what makes the change a recorded act.
